page.overview:
Who is Vidor?

Vidor was a supporting antagonist in Invincible series, debuting in Season 2.

He was a loyal Viltrumite warrior of the Viltrum Empire, committed to its mission of universal domination. Ultimately, Vidor was killed by Nolan during the Battle of Thraxa.

Vidor was a blond male Viltrumite sporting a classic Viltrumite mustache. Vidor seemed to have two screw bolts on his head. And his overall physique looks thinner and less muscular than Nolan's, but more agile.

Vidor dressed in a classic white Viltrumite uniform and had a transparent yellow visor on his eyes.
